cases.sentence: Один человек из Вифлеема в Иудее отправился жить в страну ___.
cases.translation: A certain man from Bethlehem in Judah went to live in the country of Moab.
cases.explain: The preposition в (to) with the genitive case shows direction to a location in the context of origin/departure.

cases.sentence: Этого человека звали Элемелех, его ___ - Наимень, а двоих его сыновей - Махлон и Хелион.
cases.translation: The man's name was Elimelech, and his wife's name was Naomi, and his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion.
cases.explain: Жену is the object of the verb звали (they called), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они были ефремитяне из Вифлеема, и они пришли в ___.
cases.translation: They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem, and they came to Moab.
cases.explain: The preposition в (to/into) with motion toward a place governs the accusative case, which for this noun is the same as nominative.

cases.sentence: Элемелех, муж Наимени, умер, и она осталась с двумя ___ .
cases.translation: Elimelech, Naomi's husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case to show accompaniment.

cases.sentence: Они женились на маавитянках, одну из них звали Орфа, другую - ___.
cases.translation: They took wives from the women of Moab. One was called Orpah and the other Ruth.
cases.explain: Руфь is indeclinable and remains the same in the accusative case after the verb звали (they called).

cases.sentence: Услышав в Моаве, что Господь пришел на помощь своему ___, дав им пищу, Наимень приготовилась вернуться домой.
cases.translation: Hearing in Moab that Yahweh had visited his people, giving them bread, Naomi prepared to return home.
cases.explain: The preposition к, implied in 'пришел на помощь' (came to help), governs the dative case showing the recipient of the help.

cases.sentence: Вместе со своими снохами она покинула место, где жила, и отправилась в дорогу, которая должна была привезти их обратно в землю ___.
cases.translation: So she left the place where she was living and set out on the road that would take them back to the land of Judah.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into/to) with the accusative case indicates motion toward a destination.

cases.sentence: Твой народ будет моим ___, и твой Бог моим Богом.
cases.translation: Your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
cases.explain: Народ is a predicate nominative after the verb будет (will be), so it takes the nominative case.

reading.ru: Один человек из Вифлеема в Иудее вместе со своей женой и двумя сыновьями отправился жить в страну Мааф.
reading.question: Why did Elimelech and his family leave Bethlehem?
options: Because of a famine in the land
Because they were chased by enemies
Because they wanted to visit relatives
Because the king commanded them to leave
reading.correct: Because of a famine in the land
reading.explain: The text states 'в дни... в стране случился голод' (in those days there was a famine in the land), which forced them to leave.

reading.ru: Они были ефремитяне из Вифлеема, что находится в Иудее.
reading.question: Where did the Ephrathites mentioned come from?
options: From the hill country of Ephraim
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'ефремитяне из Вифлеема, что находится в Иудее' (Ephrathites from Bethlehem, which is in Judah).

reading.ru: Элемелех, муж Наимени, умер, и она осталась с двумя сыновьями.
reading.question: What happened to Elimelech?
reading.explain: The text clearly states 'Элемелех, муж Наимени, умер' (Elimelech, the husband of Naomi, died).

reading.ru: После того, как они прожили там около десяти лет, Махлон и Хелион тоже умерли, и Наимень осталась без своих сыновей и мужа.
reading.question: How long did Naomi live in Moab before her sons died?
reading.explain: The text states 'они прожили там около десяти лет' (they lived there about ten years).

reading.ru: Услышав в Моаве, что Господь пришел на помощь своему народу, дав им пищу, Наимень со своими снохами приготовилась вернуться домой.
reading.question: What news did Naomi hear in Moab that made her want to return home?
options: That the Lord had visited His people and given them bread
That her husband was still alive
That a new king had taken the throne
That the Moabites would force them to leave
reading.correct: That the Lord had visited His people and given them bread
reading.explain: The text says she heard 'что Господь пришел на помощь своему народу, дав им пищу' (that the Lord had come to help His people by giving them food).

reading.ru: Твой народ будет моим народом, и твой Бог моим Богом.
reading.question: Who made this promise?
reading.explain: Ruth made this declaration to Naomi, pledging her loyalty and commitment to remain with her and her people.
